notes.title: Alpha 0.9.3.8 Update - Sensitivity Setting for Controller Inputs
notes.notes:
Here is the long overdo upgrade to steering sensitivity, which vastly improves the driving experience.
Also customized it,  'Axis Sensitivity' has been added to the Input Manager for more control.

The default Steering Axis Sensitivity has been changed from '1' to '.01' if a controller is detected.
(Tested on an X-Box Controller, Retrolink, Thrustmaster Wheel and Oculus Quest hands).

notes.title: Update Notes for September 2021
notes.notes:
Trying to get back into development on this game.

The game is now using Unity's XR System and will hopefully better for more HMDs.

Exciting news: The Keyboard Mouse Version is also included in the build. You don't need to play in VR anymore. Do remember to set your inputs to the desire controllers before racing.

ahh lots more stuff.. and more soon .. thanks Moga

notes.title: Critical Gravity is near Early Access release
notes.notes:
'Critical Gravity' alpha is nearing Early Access release for players who can't wait. It is also an opportunity for those player and developers who would like to steer the game to give their input and feedback at this early stage.

There are many non-functioning parts to the game so it will be heavily discounted in Early Access. 

Thank you Community!
